readings: Using only films whose `replacement_cost` is more than 20.99, find for each `rating` the average running time (`length`) and the average ratio of `rental_rate` to `replacement_cost` (ignoring missing values). Then return one row with the average of those per-rating average lengths and the average of those per-rating average ratios, in that order and unrounded.
queries:
SELECT AVG(avg_length), AVG(avg_ratio)
FROM (
  SELECT rating,
         AVG(length) AS avg_length,
         AVG(rental_rate / replacement_cost) AS avg_ratio
  FROM film
  WHERE replacement_cost > 20.99
  GROUP BY rating
);
